# Reckoner state

Generated by `npm run status` (in `tools/reckoner`) from the guide YAML, catalogue and action plan.
**Do not edit by hand.** It is refreshed by `npm run publish:pages`, and `npm run check:pages` (run in CI)
fails if it is out of date. Read it before drafting reckoner content or a handoff, and trust it over memory.

## Phases with no examples

Authoring targets. A guide with phase groups needs a positive and a negative example once per group, not per phase.

- 7e → engage (Engage)
- 7e → explore (Explore)
- 7e → explain (Explain)
- 7e → evaluate (Evaluate)
- adi → design-data (Design the method and collect data)
- adi → reflective-discussion (Explicit and reflective discussion)
- adi → peer-review (Double-blind peer review)
- adi → revision (Revision and submission)
- swh → tests (Tests)
- swh → observations (Observations)
- swh → reflection (Reflection)

## Nesting links to models without a guide

These show as "guide coming soon" links inside published guides.

- 5e hosts ssi (SSI-based teaching)
- poe nests-in glm (Generative Learning Model)
- poe nests-in ast (Ambitious Science Teaching)

## Scripts

Run from `tools/reckoner`: `npm run validate`, `npm run export-schema`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test`, `npm run build`, `npm run build:single`, `npm run review`, `npm run publish:pages`, `npm run check:pages`, `npm run status`, `npm run check:regressions`.
